question: Can any place within the brahmanda remain unknown to Hayagriva?
premises: No place within brahmanda is unknown to me.
The verse denies any unknown location.
inference: Hayagriva claims omniscience over every place in the brahmanda.
uncertainties: Exact speaker and addressee depend on surrounding context.
Fused sandhi form hyaviditaṃ may include hi.
plain_english: There is no place within the brahmanda that is ever unknown to me.
